# SPY Salon – Complete Authentication System Audit Report

**Date:** Generated by automated auth audit workflow  
**Scope:** Flutter mobile (`mobile_app/`) · Next.js web (`frontend/`) · Node.js backend (`backend/src/`)  
**Audit method:** Static source-code inspection only — no terminal commands, builds, or browser sessions executed.

---

## A. Root Cause of "Age is required" Error

**Finding:** The error string "Age is required, Required, Required, Required, Required" does **not exist in any current source file** across all three codebases. Exhaustive search of all `.dart`, `.ts`, `.tsx`, and `.js` files in `frontend/`, `backend/src/`, and `mobile_app/lib/` returned zero matches for "age" in any validation context.

**Root cause (historical):** The error was produced by a **previous version of the backend** that used a Joi validation schema requiring `age`, `gender`, `dob`, and related fields. The comma-joined format is consistent with Joi's `error.details.map(e => e.message).join(', ')` pattern. The current backend's `validateRequest` middleware returns only the **first** error via `ApiError.badRequest(firstErrorMessage)` — that format cannot produce the observed string with the current code.

**Current state:** The backend's `POST /api/v1/auth/register` route validates only `name` (required), `password` (required + min 6 chars), `email` (format), and `phone` (format). No `age` field is required or referenced anywhere.

**Runtime verification needed:** Confirm the running backend is the current source version. If an older deployed instance (pre-replacement) is still answering requests, the age error will persist until that instance is restarted with the current code.

## B. All Issues Found and Fixed

### B1. Web Frontend

| # | Issue | Severity | Status |
|---|-------|----------|--------|
| 1 | `AuthContext.register` implementation parameter type was `{ name, email, phone, password }` — stripped `termsAccepted`, `privacyPolicyAccepted`, `termsVersion`, `privacyPolicyVersion` from JSON body despite the interface declaring them | Low | **FIXED** |
| 2 | `reset-password/page.tsx` success redirect sent user to `/book` instead of `/login` — user is unauthenticated after a password reset | Medium | **FIXED** |
| 3 | `forgot-password/page.tsx` minimum password length validation was 4 characters; backend `isValidPassword` requires ≥ 6 | Low | **FIXED** |
| 4 | `login/page.tsx` email input had no hint that employees use staff codes (e.g. `EMP-1001`) — UX only | Low | **FIXED** |
| 5 | `reset-password/page.tsx` reads `?token=` from URL but backend expects `{ email, otp, password }` — the page is a legacy link-flow that has no matching backend endpoint | High | **Mitigated** — success redirect now goes to `/login`; the broken token flow was already guarded by the backend returning an error. Full fix (redirect `/reset-password` → `/forgot-password`) is a product decision — the page still renders but backend will reject the call without a valid email+OTP. Documented in Remaining Items. |

### B2. Backend

| # | Issue | Severity | Status |
|---|-------|----------|--------|
| 6 | `authMiddleware.js` hardcoded fallback `'spysalon_super_secret_jwt_key_2026'` — if `JWT_SECRET` env var was missing, any attacker reading the source could forge valid JWTs | **HIGH** | **FIXED** — fallback removed; throws fatal startup error if `JWT_SECRET` is unset |
| 7 | Asymmetric JWT secret: `authService.js` used no fallback while `authMiddleware.js` did — tokens signed in one path could be rejected in another on misconfigured deployments | Medium | **FIXED** as a side effect of #6; `authMiddleware` now reads `JWT_SECRET` consistently with `authService` |
| 8 | `authService.sendLoginOtp` auto-creates a user for any unknown email (account-enumeration + spam-creation vector) | Medium | **Not modified** — existing `otpSendLimiter` partially mitigates; full fix requires product decision on whether auto-registration for OTP flow should be disabled. Documented in Remaining Items. |
| 9 | `authMiddleware.js` does not check `user.isVerified` — currently not exploitable because registration sets `isVerified: true` automatically | Low | **Not modified** — no current exploit path; documented for future reference. |

### B3. Flutter Mobile

| # | Issue | Severity | Status |
|---|-------|----------|--------|
| 10 | `login_screen.dart` phone validation accepted any 10+ digit number; backend requires first digit 6/7/8/9 (Indian mobile) | Low | **FIXED** — added first-digit guard |
| 11 | `splash_screen.dart` navigated to dashboard with an expired JWT, causing all subsequent API calls to 401 — poor UX (dashboard loads then immediately breaks) | Medium | **FIXED** — added `_isJwtExpired()` helper; expired tokens trigger `ApiService.tryRefreshToken()`; refresh failure clears session and falls back to onboarding |
| 12 | `markAllNotificationsRead` POST body contained PII (`userId`, `email`, `role`) | Medium | **Already fixed** in previous notification audit (H1) |
| 13 | Cold-launch `getInitialMessage` navigated to `NotificationScreen` without checking auth state | Medium | **Already fixed** in previous notification audit (H2) — 2800ms delay + JWT guard |
| 14 | `Colors.transparent` hardcoded for read notification tiles instead of theme token | Low | **Already fixed** in previous notification audit (H3) — replaced with `themeColors.cardSurface` |

## C. Files Modified

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `frontend/context/AuthContext.tsx` | Widened `register` implementation parameter type to include `termsAccepted?`, `privacyPolicyAccepted?`, `termsVersion?`, `privacyPolicyVersion?`; all fields now forwarded in `JSON.stringify(formData)` |
| `frontend/app/reset-password/page.tsx` | Changed success redirect from `router.push('/book')` to `router.push('/login')` |
| `frontend/app/forgot-password/page.tsx` | Changed minimum password length check from `password.length < 4` to `password.length < 6` — now matches backend `isValidPassword` requirement |
| `frontend/app/login/page.tsx` | Added helper hint text below email input: "Customers: use your email. Employees: use your staff code (e.g. EMP-1001)." |
| `backend/src/middlewares/authMiddleware.js` | (1) Extracted `JWT_SECRET` at module load, throws `Error` at startup if unset; (2) removed hardcoded `'spysalon_super_secret_jwt_key_2026'` fallback from both `protect` and `optionalAuth` |
| `mobile_app/lib/screens/login_screen.dart` | Added first-digit validation in `_handleRegister`: rejects phone numbers whose first digit is not 6, 7, 8, or 9 |
| `mobile_app/lib/screens/splash_screen.dart` | (1) Added `dart:convert` import; (2) added `_isJwtExpired(String token)` helper that decodes JWT exp claim without external dependencies; (3) Stage 3 of `_initializeApp` now checks token expiry for non-admin sessions — calls `ApiService.tryRefreshToken()` on expiry, clears session if refresh fails |

## D. API Contract Compatibility Verification

| Endpoint | Flutter payload | Web payload | Backend expectation | Compatible? |
|----------|----------------|-------------|---------------------|-------------|
| `POST /api/v1/auth/register` | `{ name, email, phone, password, termsAccepted, privacyPolicyAccepted, termsVersion, privacyPolicyVersion }` | Same (now correctly forwarded by `AuthContext.register`) | Validates `name`, `password`, `email`, `phone` — ignores extra fields | ✅ Yes |
| `POST /api/v1/auth/login` | `{ identifier, password }` | `{ email, password }` | `identifier \|\| email \|\| phone` — both accepted | ✅ Yes |
| `POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password` | N/A (mobile uses OTP login via `/send-otp`) | `{ email }` | `{ email }` | ✅ Yes |
| `POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password` | N/A | `{ email, otp, password }` | `{ email, otp, password }` | ✅ Yes (when called from `forgot-password` page which passes all three) |
| `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` | `{ refreshToken }` | `{ refreshToken }` | `{ refreshToken }` | ✅ Yes |
| `PATCH /api/v1/notifications/read-all` | `{}` (PII removed) | N/A | `req.user` from JWT | ✅ Yes |

**Note:** `reset-password/page.tsx` calls `resetPassword(token, password)` which serialises as `{ email: '', otp: token, password }` — the backend will reject this because `email` is empty. This page's flow remains broken at the protocol level; see Remaining Items.

## E. Security Review Findings

| Finding | Severity | Disposition |
|---------|----------|-------------|
| Hardcoded `'spysalon_super_secret_jwt_key_2026'` fallback in `authMiddleware.js` — public constant allows JWT forgery if `.env` is absent | **HIGH** | **Fixed** — throws fatal startup error |
| Asymmetric JWT secret handling between `authService.js` (no fallback) and `authMiddleware.js` (had fallback) | Medium | **Fixed** — both now use `process.env.JWT_SECRET` with no fallback |
| `authService.sendLoginOtp` auto-creates accounts for unknown emails (account enumeration + spam creation) | Medium | Partially mitigated by existing `otpSendLimiter`; full fix is a product decision |
| `authMiddleware.js` does not check `user.isVerified` | Low | Not currently exploitable (registration sets `isVerified: true`); documented for future verification flow |
| Role injection at registration is impossible | N/A (secure) | `authService.register` hardcodes `role: 'customer'`; controller does not pass client-supplied role |
| Admin JWT discarded in Flutter app | N/A (secure) | Both `login_screen.dart` and `splash_screen.dart` call `clearSession()` and refuse navigation for admin/manager roles |
| JWT access tokens remain valid 15 min after password reset | Acceptable | `authService.resetPasswordWithOtp` revokes refresh tokens; 15-min access token lifetime limits the window |
| Notification endpoints secured with `protect` middleware | Fixed (previous audit) | `GET /notifications`, `GET /notifications/unread`, `PATCH /notifications/read-all` all require valid JWT |
| `markAllNotificationsRead` no longer sends PII in body | Fixed (previous audit) | Identity derived exclusively from `req.user` |

## F. Remaining Items That Require Runtime / Device Testing

1. **Confirm backend version** — the "Age is required" error cannot occur with the current source, but it will persist if an older deployed instance is still running. Restart the backend to confirm the error is gone.

2. **`reset-password/page.tsx` legacy flow** — this page reads `?token=` from the URL but the backend only accepts `{ email, otp, password }`. The page has no `email` collection field, so the API call will always fail. **Product decision needed:** either redirect `/reset-password` → `/forgot-password` (recommended — the full OTP flow lives there), or add an email input and restructure the page. The success-redirect bug (`/book` → `/login`) was fixed regardless.

3. **`authService.sendLoginOtp` auto-registration** — disabling auto-creation for unknown emails in the OTP flow is a product decision that affects the current user onboarding experience.

4. **`authMiddleware.js` startup check** — after deploying the secret-removal fix, verify `JWT_SECRET` is set in the production `.env` before restarting the server, or the process will refuse to start (by design).

5. **Flutter token refresh on cold launch** — the `_isJwtExpired` + `tryRefreshToken` path needs to be verified on a real device: (a) log in, (b) wait for the 15-min access token to expire without using the app, (c) relaunch — the splash screen should silently refresh the token and navigate to the dashboard.

6. **Flutter phone validation edge cases** — confirm the first-digit guard does not reject valid numbers that begin with a leading `+91` country code (the `cleanPhone` stripping of non-digits removes the `+` and `91`, leaving a valid 10-digit local number — confirmed by inspection, no issue).

7. **FCM cold-launch navigation** (previous audit item) — requires physical Android device and live Firebase project for verification.

8. **Backend `/api/v1/auth/register` runtime test** — submit the complete registration payload from both web and Flutter; confirm `termsAccepted` and consent fields are stored correctly.
